## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T05:22Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: 7ec78e2747fecaf0f64367e3249b0cdd3aa757d3
Card: #34607 (triage 6937264999, ruling 6939109581) · claim 6937557686 · amendment 6938698182 · os-dev-reports 6938668275 (round 0), 6938947342 (round 1)

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

None.

### Readings that hold

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34607`, kept by the seat's ruling 6939109581 (the attachments half of item 3 goes to a follow-up card). No `!`, no `(narrowing)`: no dogfood battery owed. `mergeable_state` clean. |
| Scope | 7 files, all inside claim 6937557686 plus amendment 6938698182: `ModalForm.tsx` (column and size hunks plus the sectioned call), `autoLayout.ts` (a new dialog-only helper and an optional trailing parameter), three tests under `src/__tests__/`, `README.md` (the amended section) and the changeset. The app-shell pin named "only if its pin moves" did not move and is untouched. |
| Shared defaults untouched | `sectionColumnsFor`, `sectionedFormColumns` and `sectionedGridLayout` gain `undeclared: number = UNDECLARED_SECTION_COLUMNS` as a trailing parameter. Every page host (`ObjectForm`, `TabbedForm`, `WizardForm`) calls them without it, so their output is byte-for-byte what it was; `UNDECLARED_SECTION_COLUMNS`, `inferColumns`, `CONTAINER_GRID_COLS` and `WIDE_FIELD_TYPES` are unchanged. This matches the card's 「不改整页表单的现有推断」 and the claim's "shared defaults untouched". |
| Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | `no` / `none` in body, changeset and claim. `@object-ui/plugin-form` is published, with two entries: `.` (`src/index.tsx`) and `./core` (`src/core.ts`). Neither re-exports `dialogUndeclaredColumns`, `sectionColumnsFor`, `sectionedFormColumns` or `sectionedGridLayout`; the autoLayout names they do export (`inferColumns`, `inferModalSize`, `containerGridColsFor`, …) keep their signatures. No spec or schema key: `FormSectionSchema.columns` already leaves an undeclared count to the renderer (`view.mdx` reference: "Undeclared: the renderer's choice by available width"), so no L2 is owed. |
| The rule, read against the code | `dialogUndeclaredColumns(n, size) = min(max(2, inferColumns(n)), size === 'full' ? 4 : 3)`. With `inferColumns` at ≤3→1, ≤8→2, ≤15→3, else 4, that gives 2 up to eight fields, 3 from nine, and 4 from sixteen only in `full`, as the changeset and README say. |
| The cap, by arithmetic | `xl` is `sm:max-w-5xl` (64rem); less the scroller's `sm:px-6` the field container is about 61rem, over `@4xl` (56rem) and `@2xl` (42rem). A four-wide class there would draw four columns, so a literal `containerGridColsFor(4)` would break acceptance 1; the size-tied cap is the right reading of the card. `full` is reached only when authored (`inferModalSize` returns `lg`/`xl`). |
| No size/count cycle | `effectiveModalSize` reads the declared grid or the floor of 2 (`DIALOG_DEFAULT_COLUMNS`) and the field count, never `undeclaredColumns`, which is computed after it from the size. Inferred sizes are unchanged from main for every input. |
| The three arms | Flat: `flatColumns = schema.columns ?? undeclaredColumns` into `applyAutoLayout`. Authored sections: `sectionedGridLayout(schema.columns, …, undeclaredColumns)`. Field groups: the derived sections no longer carry a stamped `columns`, and the arm reads `clampColumns(schema.columns) ?? undeclaredColumns`; the size path sees the same undeclared sections as before, so its reading is unchanged. A declared `columns`, `1` included, wins on every arm (ruling 6204264665 kept). |
| Existing-test edits | `dialogDefaultLayout-12521`: four expectations move from the 2-wide to the 3-wide grid because its twelve-field fixture now infers three; the size (`sm:max-w-5xl`), one-cell-per-field and wide-row pins stay. The `@md:`-prefix check widens to `@` because the three-wide grid adds an `@2xl:` tier; it still asserts every multi-column tier is a container query over a one-column base. `undeclaredSectionDensity-12592`: the page-equals-dialog byte check is replaced, for the field-heavy fixture only, by explicit ladders (page `[2,2,2]`, dialog `[2,3,3]`); the light fixture still matches byte for byte. Each edit follows from the card's change; none drops a check without a replacement. |
| Docs | The README section "Column width of a sectioned form" now gives both counts and drops the stale "without either it is single-column" (the page default has been 2 since objectui#12592). `content/docs` and `skills` have no sentence about the dialog's default column count; the `columns` reference text stays true. |
| Changeset | Names `@object-ui/plugin-form`, the one package whose `src` moved. Every sentence matches the readings above, including "the dialog's inferred size (`lg` or `xl`) is unchanged" and "full-page, tabbed and wizard forms are unchanged". |
| Acceptance | 1 (three in a bounded dialog, four in `full`), 2 (declared `columns: 2` stays 2), 4 (phone one column, below `@md`) and the long-text / sub-table half of 3 (wide kinds take the row at four) are pinned in `dialogContainerColumns-34607` (14 tests). The attachments half of 3 is ruled out of this card (6939109581). |
| Tests | Real commands with output: plugin-form 234 files / 2607 passed on the round-0 code (round 1 changed only the README and body); type-check exit 0; the two app-shell size pins 21/21 unchanged. One ablation (`cap = 4`) turns 5 of the 14 new pins red and was restored to the HEAD blob. 38 + 19 derived gates, all exit 0. |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34645`: NOT governed, 540 lines (+463/−77). Tier S, lands through o3-B. |
| CI on this head | 56 check-runs: all `success` or `skipped`. Test UI (aggregate plus every planned shard), Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are all `success`. The round-0 Test UI red was a concurrency cancel when this head was pushed (report 6938947342); this head's own run is green. |

### Notes

1. **Not measured in a browser.** jsdom evaluates no container query, so the tier claim rests on the class reading and the rem arithmetic above, which I checked. If the landing area boots the console, a glance at a 9+ field create dialog at 1280px (three per row) is the cheapest confirmation.
2. An **authored** `lg` dialog with nine or more fields gets the three-wide class, but its field container (42rem less the padding) is under `@2xl`, so it draws two. That is what the changeset says ("columns still follow the dialog's real width"); it is not a defect.
3. **Follow-up card** from ruling 6939109581: multi-file `file`/`image` fields take the full row in the form auto-layout, mirroring plugin-detail's `MULTI_FILE_FIELD_TYPES`. The seat files it.
4. **Serial:** `ModalForm.tsx` is shared with #34599 and #34642 (disjoint hunks, overlap-check clean), and #34604 queues after this card on the same `effectiveModalSize` hunk. Whichever lands second merges main; a clean merge needs no new L1, a conflict in these hunks does.
